object.name: evi_bp
object.description: A linear twopole resonant bandpass filter, a port of [bp~] from Pd and therefore a direct form biquad. Similar to <o>reson~</o> and <o>evi.reson~</o> but with no feedforward gains and thus a special and smooth alternative to those filters. Like <o>reson</o> etc it can take very high Q values which is one of it's primary use cases. [bp~] is basically a control rate version of [vcf~] from Pd, which is also ported in evieve as <o>evi.vcf~</o>.

inlets.name: cutoff
inlets.digest: Center frequency of the resonant peak.

inlets.name: q
inlets.digest: Filter resonance. Can be increasingly high values (e.g. 10000).

attributes.name: filter
attributes.description: Gain filter off/on. If off (the default) identical to Pd [bp~] (no gain inlet). If on, ± gain inlet takes effect. Switching this also resets internal filter (biquad) state.
